ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with a high-intensity (white) pixel ratio of approximately 1:9 across the visible area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark field across both lobes. Discrete white mottling cluster situated on the medial edge of the left lobe adjacent to the notch. Fine-grain white speckling concentrated along the lower center and ventral regions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 62 degrees and a depth approximately 15% of the total lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across both trailing edges. Left lobe displays 4-5 primary jagged peaks; right lobe displays a more continuous series of smaller saw-tooth variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex sweep on the superior edges transitioning to tapered, pointed lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular white pixel clusters localized on the distal tip of the right lobe and smaller constellations on the dorsal-facing surface of the left lobe tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct, vertically oriented parallel high-contrast linear streaks (rake marks) located on the mid-lateral section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Parallel rake mark scarring on the right lobe; significant encrustations on both fluke tips consistent with barnacle colonization.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of brownish, amorphous organic material or algal growth trailing from the outer edges of both fluke tips.
